documents.title: Finance Transformation Roadmap — Planning on Snowflake
documents.excerpt: Group planning already migrated TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake with EY. BU planning on Oracle EPM is paused; FY2027 cycle to run on Snowflake with Sigma input grids, workflow and full audit trail.

documents.title: NHS Elective Waiting List — Monthly RTT Statistics
documents.excerpt: Referral-to-treatment waiting list remains above 7 million. Self-pay and PMI demand for orthopaedics, diagnostics and cataracts continues to grow, supporting Cromwell Hospital and clinic volumes.

documents.title: UK Medical Claims Inflation Outlook FY2027
documents.excerpt: Private medical claims inflation expected at 6-8% in 2027, driven by provider tariffs, oncology drug costs and mental health utilisation. Insurers repricing corporate schemes accordingly.

documents.title: Care Home Occupancy & Agency Staffing Report
documents.excerpt: Average occupancy 89%. Agency nursing at 14% of direct care cost, above 9% target. Highest agency dependency in the Midlands & East cluster.

documents.title: Private Dental Membership Growth — Q3 Review
documents.excerpt: Private membership plans up 9% YoY; chair utilisation at 81%. NHS contract activity flat, with UDA value unchanged for FY2027.

documents.title: Oracle EPM & Business Objects Licence Renewal
documents.excerpt: Oracle EPM renewal due Q1 FY2027 alongside Business Objects. Decommissioning both after the Snowflake and Sigma migration avoids an estimated GBP 4.2M annual run cost.

documents.title: Cortex AI Security Approval
documents.excerpt: Snowflake Cortex AI functions approved for use on finance and claims data within the Bupa Snowflake account. Data stays inside the governance boundary; no external model training.

documents.title: PeopleSoft GL End-of-Life Assessment
documents.excerpt: PeopleSoft GL approaching end of support. Shortlist includes Snowflake-native options; any replacement must feed the planning model directly to avoid a new reconciliation layer.

documents.title: Local Authority Care Fee Uplifts 2027
documents.excerpt: Fee uplifts confirmed at 6.5% in Scotland and Wales versus 4% assumed in the draft plan. English authorities averaging 5%.

documents.title: Bupa Global FX Sensitivity
documents.excerpt: International premiums are 62% USD-linked. A 1.32 USD/GBP rate reduces sterling revenue by around GBP 16M versus plan rates.
